title: [dev-i] No backfilling of treatment data to Nightscout if server isn't available
body: I back up my FC and AAPS data to a Nightscout installation on my NAS. At night I turn it off to save power (from 1 to 6 o'clock). At 6 o'clock xDrip+ syncs all blood glucose data, but AAPS not my treatment data. NSClientV3: websockets deactivated Nightscout: 15.0.0
